name: quickgpt

author: ddhjy2012

commands.description: Browse your prompt library, fill placeholders, then copy, paste, or run an AppleScript.

preferences.title: Pinned Actions
preferences.description: Comma-separated pinned actions. Built-in names: copyToClipboard, paste, copyAsFile. Script names match the AppleScript filename without extension.

preferences.name: customEditor
preferences.title: Editor Application
preferences.description: Application used to open and edit prompt files (`.hjson`). Leave empty to use the system default app.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
